say.text: Clean shot from range, {lord}! Now step into a live team bout. Starly, Caterpie, Pawmi, onto the field!

say.text: We have been waiting on the sidelines all evening! Don't blink or we will sweep the pitch!

say.speaker: mentor
say.text: First, watch what happens when an unfavorable type matchup connects. Pawmi, spark {partner} with Nuzzle!

say.text: Cheeks charged! Coming right at you, {partner}!
